ui.views.title: Standard views
ui.outliner.empty: Groups and components you make show here. Select geometry, then {comp} makes a component, {group} a group.
ui.comps.empty: No components yet. Select geometry and press {key}: every copy of a component changes when you edit one.
ui.stage.canvas: 3D view. Pick a tool, then click in the view; type lengths into the value box at the bottom.
ui.hint.rect: {key} rectangle: click two corners on the ground, or click one and type {eg} and {enter}.
ui.hint.push: {key} push/pull: click the face, move up, click — or type a height.
ui.hint.tools: {l} line, {c} circle, {m} move ({ctrl} copies), {t} tape measure for guides.
ui.hint.group: {comp} makes the selection a component, {group} a group.
ui.hint.camera: Middle-drag orbits, {shift}+middle-drag or right-drag pans, the wheel zooms. Arrow keys lock red, green and blue.
ui.hint.local: Models open and save on this computer; nothing is uploaded.
ui.drop: Drop a model, Collada, OBJ, glTF, DWG or DXF
ui.colors.note: Pick a color, then click faces, groups or components with Paint (B). With something selected, a click on a color paints the selection.
ui.materials.note: Paint faces with brick, siding, roofing, wood, stone and more, like a color: pick one, then click faces. Textures show in the Shaded style and in rendered pictures; exports get each material’s color.
ui.lights.note: Lamps light rendered pictures (Export › Render a picture…), most of all at night. Click Lamp, Spotlight or Light panel, then click where it goes; click a lamp’s mark in the view to change it.
ui.scenes.empty: A scene saves this camera and style. Add a few, then step through them with {up} / {down} or Play.
ui.vcb.kbd.title: Letters keyboard, for typing units (m, ft, ', ")
ui.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts and mouse buttons (also in Settings)
ui.snap.title: Snap to points, edges and axes
ui.collide.title: Stop solids where they touch, instead of passing through
set.scroll.hint: Trackpad: swipe with two fingers to orbit, hold Shift and swipe to pan, pinch to zoom — no camera buttons needed. Mouse wheel: the wheel zooms. "Work it out" treats sideways or fine-grained scrolling as a trackpad.
set.touch2.hint: Two fingers also pinch to zoom; three fingers do the other one. Hold one finger still on empty space, then drag, to orbit with one finger. While you draw, a loupe above your finger shows the points it snaps to.
set.snap.snap: Snap to points, edges and axes
set.snap.collide: Stop solids where they touch (no passing through)
set.snap.hint: Both are also buttons at the bottom right of the view, so you can turn them off for one move and back on.
set.corner.hint: The view cube sits at the top right of the view: click a face, edge or corner to look from there, drag it to orbit, drag the compass ring to turn the model. The axis icon is a small X, Y, Z marker at the bottom left.
app.ctx.editing: Editing {name}. Esc or double-click outside closes it.
app.keys.hint.blender: G, R and S move, rotate and scale the selection straight away (X, Y or Z locks an axis), E pushes and pulls, Shift+D duplicates, Tab opens a group, the numpad picks views. Middle-drag orbits; Alt + drag orbits without a middle button.
app.keys.hint.sketchup: Push-pull keys: L line, R rectangle, P push/pull, M move, Q rotate, S scale, G component. Middle-drag orbits, right-drag pans.
app.keys.set.blender: Modeler keys: G grab, R rotate, S scale, E extrude (push/pull), Shift+D duplicate.
app.keys.set.sketchup: Push-pull keys: L line, R rectangle, P push/pull, M move, Q rotate.
app.snap.off: Snapping off: nothing pulls the cursor to points, edges or axes.
app.collide.off: Collide off: solids can pass through each other.
app.collide.on: Collide on: moving and push/pull stop where solids touch.
app.btitle.move: Move (G moves the selection at once; Shift+D duplicates)
app.btitle.erase: Eraser (X or Delete deletes the selection)
app.btitle.dim: Dimension: click two corners or an edge, then type a new length to resize (D)
app.btitle.pan: Pan: Shift + middle-drag, or Alt+Shift + drag
app.btitle.zoom: Zoom: the wheel, or Ctrl + middle-drag
app.hint.su.rect: {key} rectangle: click two corners on the ground, or click one and type {eg} and {enter}.
app.hint.su.push: {key} push/pull: click the face, move up, click — or type a height.
app.hint.su.tools: {l} line, {c} circle, {m} move ({ctrl} copies), {t} tape measure for guides.
app.hint.su.group: {comp} makes the selection a component, {shift}+{g} a group. {ctrl}+{c} / {v} copy and paste.
app.hint.su.camera: Middle-drag orbits, {shift}+middle-drag or right-drag pans, the wheel zooms. On a trackpad, see Settings ({ctrl}+{comma}).
app.hint.bl.push: {key} push/pull (extrude): click the face, move, click — or type a distance.
app.hint.bl.grab: Select, then {g} grab, {r} rotate, {s} scale — {x} {y} {z} lock an axis, click or {enter} to finish, {esc} cancels.
app.hint.bl.keys: {shift}+{d} duplicates, {x} deletes, {a} selects all, {tab} opens a group, {ctrl}+{g} groups.
app.hint.bl.camera: Middle-drag orbits, {shift}+middle pans, {ctrl}+middle zooms; {alt}+drag orbits without a middle button. Numpad {n1} {n3} {n7} views.
app.outliner.empty.bl: Groups and components you make show here. Select geometry, then {group} makes a group, {comp} a component.
app.paint.start: Paint: {color}. Click faces, groups or components.
app.touch.hold: Hold still on something to finish a tool; tap to click.
app.touch.orbit: Drag to orbit; lift to stop.
app.tab.none: Select a group or component, then Tab opens it.
app.lock.red: Locked to the red axis. Press the same key to unlock.
app.lock.green: Locked to the green axis. Press the same key to unlock.
app.lock.blue: Locked to the blue axis. Press the same key to unlock.
app.lock.edge: Locked to the last edge. Press the same key to unlock.

app.hide.done.one: Hid {n} thing. Edit › More › Unhide all shows everything again.
app.hide.done.other: Hid {n} things. Edit › More › Unhide all shows everything again.

app.isolate.none: Select what to keep first; Isolate hides the rest.

app.isolate.done.one: Isolated the selection: hid {n} other thing. Unhide all shows it again.
app.isolate.done.other: Isolated the selection: hid {n} other things. Unhide all shows them again.

app.isolate.done.group.one: Isolated the selection: hid {n} other thing in this group. Unhide all shows it again.
app.isolate.done.group.other: Isolated the selection: hid {n} other things in this group. Unhide all shows them again.

app.unhide.done.one: Showing everything again ({n} thing was hidden).
app.unhide.done.other: Showing everything again ({n} things were hidden).

app.group.none: Select some geometry first (drag a window, or triple-click to select everything connected).
app.explode.none: Select a group or component to explode.
app.copy.empty: Nothing to copy in that selection.

app.copy.done.one: Copied {n} item. Ctrl+V pastes (the copy follows the cursor), Ctrl+Shift+V pastes in place.
app.copy.done.other: Copied {n} items. Ctrl+V pastes (the copy follows the cursor), Ctrl+Shift+V pastes in place.

app.paste.none: Nothing to paste: copy something first (Ctrl+C).
app.dup.done: Duplicated: move it and click to put it down, or type a distance. Esc cancels.
app.present.on: Presentation view: guides, axes, snapping marks and the selection are hidden. Shift+P shows them again.
app.present.off: Guides, axes, snapping marks and the selection show again.
app.sun.info: Sun {alt}° up, {az}° from north. North is the green axis.
app.sun.down: The sun is down at this time.
app.scene.saved: {name} saved: this camera, style and what is hidden.
app.scene.play.few: Add two or more scenes to play them.
app.scene.go.title: Go to this scene
app.scene.update.title: Update: save the current camera and style into {name}
app.scene.rename.label: Scene name
app.tree.title: Click to select, double-click to open, F2 to rename, drag onto a group to move it inside
app.len.bad: Type a length above zero, such as 3m or 10'6".
app.info.note: Select something to see its size. Lengths show in {unit}.
app.info.radius.fixed: It bounds a face that was pushed or pulled, so its radius can no longer change.
app.info.edge.note: Type a new length to resize: the end further along red, green or blue moves, and what is joined to it stretches.
app.info.name: Name
app.info.dim.note: Type a new length to resize the model: the moving end and the geometry beyond it shift; faces joined to it stretch.
app.info.dim.free: An end of this dimension is not on a corner, so it only measures. Place it on two corners to resize with it.
app.units.set: Lengths in {unit}. Typed numbers without a unit use it too.
app.units.set.ftin: Lengths in {unit}. Typed numbers without a unit use it too (inches).
app.export.empty: The model is empty: draw something first.
app.export.dwg.none: DWG export is not available in this build yet: export DXF, which every CAD program opens.
app.export.cad: Exported {file} in {unit}: {faces} 3D faces, {lines} lines, {blocks} blocks placed {inserts} times.

app.export.cad.flat.one: {n} stretched group was written in place.
app.export.cad.flat.other: {n} stretched groups were written in place.

app.export.done.ifc: Exported {file}: each top-level group or component is one building element proxy.
app.export.done.dae: Exported {file} (Collada 1.4.1, Z up, meters; components stay shared).
app.open.recovered: Recovered {file}. It is not saved to a file yet.
app.open.notjson: This file is not a ModelCraft model (it is not JSON).
app.import.kind: ModelCraft imports SketchUp (.skp), Collada (.dae), OBJ, glTF (.glb/.gltf), DWG and DXF. "{file}" is none of these.
app.import.units.text: This {kind} does not say what its units are. What is one drawing unit?
app.print3d.title: Check for 3D printing
app.print3d.what.sel: What prints: the selection, as shown.
app.print3d.ready: Ready to print: closed all round, faces the right way out, nothing passing through itself.
app.print3d.notready: Not ready to print: a slicer may refuse it or print it wrong.
app.print3d.p.empty: There is nothing to print: no faces are shown or selected.

app.print3d.p.open.one: {n} edge has a face on one side only: there is a hole.
app.print3d.p.open.other: {n} edges have a face on one side only: there are holes.

app.print3d.p.nonmanifold.one: {n} edge is shared by three or more faces.
app.print3d.p.nonmanifold.other: {n} edges are shared by three or more faces.

app.print3d.p.flipped.one: {n} edge lies between faces facing opposite ways: reverse the faces that face in.
app.print3d.p.flipped.other: {n} edges lie between faces facing opposite ways: reverse the faces that face in.

app.print3d.p.inverted.one: {n} closed part is inside out: reverse its faces.
app.print3d.p.inverted.other: {n} closed parts are inside out: reverse their faces.

app.print3d.p.selfintersect.one: A part passes through itself in {n} place: intersect its faces and erase what is inside.
app.print3d.p.selfintersect.other: A part passes through itself in {n} places: intersect its faces and erase what is inside.

app.print3d.w.overlap.one: Separate parts overlap in {n} place. Slicers usually merge them.
app.print3d.w.overlap.other: Separate parts overlap in {n} places. Slicers usually merge them.

app.print3d.w.touch.one: Parts meet face to face along {n} edge. Slicers usually join them.
app.print3d.w.touch.other: Parts meet face to face along {n} edges. Slicers usually join them.

app.print3d.w.tiny: It is under 1 mm across. Check the model's units.
app.print3d.w.bed: It is larger than the printer's bed.
app.print3d.w.nobase: Nothing lies flat at the bottom: turn it so a face rests on the bed, or the slicer will need supports or a raft.
app.print3d.w.overhang: {share}% of the surface leans out more than {angle}° from upright and will need support.

app.print3d.w.degenerate.one: {n} face with no area is left out.
app.print3d.w.degenerate.other: {n} faces with no area are left out.

app.print3d.w.unchecked: The model is too large to check fully for parts passing through themselves.
app.print3d.fixhint: To find the problems in a group or component, select it, then use Show problems and Fix in Entity info.
app.import.site.empty: {file} has no lines, arcs or circles in model space to bring in.
app.import.dyn: Dynamic blocks, as the drawing shows them: {list}.
app.import.site.group: All in a group: explode it to draw on it directly.

app.import.dae.comps.one: Imported {file}: {faces} faces, {n} component in a group.
app.import.dae.comps.other: Imported {file}: {faces} faces, {n} components in a group.

app.unsaved.text: This model has changes that are not saved. Save a copy first?
app.units.start: Lengths in {unit}. Change it at the bottom right.
app.handoff.gone: The file handed over from the other app has expired or was already opened. Send it again.
app.handoff.failed: The file handed over from the other app could not be read from this browser's storage.
m3d.tool.click_to_select_drag_left_to: Click to select. Drag left to right for a window, right to left for a crossing selection. Double-click a group to open it.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_line: Click the end of the line, or type a length. Esc stops.
m3d.tool.click_the_start_of_the_line: Click the start of the line.
m3d.tool.click_the_opposite_corner_or_ty: Click the opposite corner, or type width, height (e.g. 4m,3m).
m3d.tool.click_the_first_corner_on_the: Click the first corner — on the ground or on any face.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_radius_or: Click to set the radius, or type it. Type 12s for 12 sides.
m3d.tool.click_the_start_of_the_arc: Click the start of the arc — on the ground or on any face.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_arc: Click the end of the arc, or type the length of its chord.
m3d.tool.move_to_bulge_the_arc_click: Move to bulge the arc, click, or type the bulge. Type 12s for 12 segments.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_arc: Click the center of the arc — on the ground or on any face.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_starts_or: Click where the arc starts, or type the radius.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_ends_or: Click where the arc ends, or type the angle in degrees.
m3d.tool.click_where_this_point_goes_or: Click where this point goes, or type <dx,dy,dz>. Esc puts it back.
m3d.tool.click_a_square_to_move_that: Click a square to move that point of the curve. Esc ends.
m3d.tool.click_the_next_point_enter_or: Click the next point. Enter or double-click finishes; click the first point to close it; Backspace takes the last point back.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_along: Click the face to sweep along the selected path.
m3d.tool.now_click_an_edge_of_the: Now click an edge of the path.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_then: Click the face to sweep, then an edge of the path — or select the path first.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_offset_its: Click a face to offset its edges, or select edges first. Double-click a face to repeat the last distance.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_group_or_component: Click a face, group or component to paint it. Ctrl: connected faces of that color · Shift: all faces of that color · Alt: pick up a color.
m3d.tool.move_to_push_or_pull_click: Move to push or pull, click to finish, or type a distance.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_push_or: Click a face to push or pull it. Double-click a face to repeat the last distance.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_move_from: Click a point to move from (select first, or the thing under the cursor moves). Ctrl copies.
m3d.tool.copied_type_3x_for_more_copies: Copied. Type 3x for more copies in a row, or /3 to divide the distance.
m3d.tool.click_the_centre_of_rotation_on: Click the centre of rotation (on a face to turn in its plane; arrow keys pick an axis).
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_start_the: Click a point to start the angle from.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_angle_or: Click to set the angle, or type degrees.
m3d.tool.move_to_turn_click_to_finish: Move to turn, click to finish, or type degrees. X, Y or Z picks the axis.
m3d.tool.move_to_resize_click_to_finish: Move to resize, click to finish; or type a factor (2), or one per axis (2,1,0.5 for red, green, blue).
m3d.tool.drag_or_click_a_grip_on: Drag or click a grip on the box: a corner scales evenly, an edge or a side stretches (Ctrl: about the center). Or click a point that stays put.
m3d.tool.click_the_point_that_stays_put: Click the point that stays put.
m3d.tool.click_a_reference_point_its_dis: Click a reference point (its distance is 1×).
m3d.tool.move_away_from_the_centre_to: Move away from the centre to grow, toward it to shrink; click to finish, or type a factor.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_a_group_a: Click an edge, a group, a guide or a dimension to erase it, or drag across several. Faces go with their edges.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_and_click: Move off the edge and click to place a parallel guide line, or type the offset.
m3d.tool.click_to_measure_and_drop_a: Click to measure and drop a guide point, or type a distance.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_to_start_a: Click an edge to start a guide line parallel to it, or a point to measure from.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_protrac: Click the center of the protractor — on a face it lies on that face.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_for_0_arrow: Click a point for 0° (arrow keys: stand the protractor square to red, green or blue).
m3d.tool.move_to_the_angle_15_steps: Move to the angle (15° steps snap) and click, or type the angle in degrees.
m3d.tool.move_to_place_the_dimension_lin: Move to place the dimension line and click, or type its offset.
m3d.tool.drag_to_orbit_middle_drag_orbit: Drag to orbit. Middle-drag orbits with any tool.
m3d.tool.drag_to_pan_shift_middle_drag: Drag to pan. Shift + middle-drag pans with any tool.
m3d.tool.drag_up_and_down_to_zoom: Drag up and down to zoom. The wheel zooms with any tool.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_component_goes_: Click where the component goes (its origin lands there).
m3d.tool.click_where_the_pasted_copy_goe: Click where the pasted copy goes (its lowest corner lands there). Esc cancels.
m3d.tool.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: This curve can no longer be edited (it was stretched or split); draw it again.
m3d.tool.click_two_points_or_more_for: Click two points or more for a curve.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_inside_the_open: Click a face (inside the open group).
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_of_the_path: Click an edge of the path.
m3d.tool.that_edge_is_part_of_the: That edge is part of the face: click an edge of the path.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_inside_the_open_2: Click a face (inside the open group), or select edges first.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_a_group_or: Click a face, a group or a component.
m3d.tool.push_pull_works_on_a_face: Push/pull works on a face. Click a face.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_move_first_: Select something to move first, or click on it.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_rotate_firs: Select something to rotate first, or click on it.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_scale_first: Select something to scale first, or click on it.
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_2: Type a factor above 0 (2), or three: red, green, blue (2,1,0.5).
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_such: Type a factor above 0, such as 2 or 0.5.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_first_to: Move off the edge first to show which side.
m3d.tool.move_the_pointer_first_to_show: Move the pointer first to show which side the dimension goes.
m3d.tool.type_a_length: Type a length such as 3m, 10'6" or 4m,3m.
m3d.tool.circle_center: Click the center — on the ground or on any face. Type {eg}s to change the sides (now {n}).
m3d.tool.curve_done: Curve through {n} points. Select it and click Edit points in Entity info to change it.
m3d.tool.curve_done_closed: Closed curve through {n} points. Select it and click Edit points in Entity info to change it.

m3d.tool.follow_ring.one: Swept along {n} edge: {faces} new faces, a closed ring.
m3d.tool.follow_ring.other: Swept along {n} edges: {faces} new faces, a closed ring.

m3d.tool.stopped_at: Stopped where it touches, at {d}. Turn off Collide (bottom right) to pass through.
m3d.tool.move_where: Click where it goes, or type a distance. Ctrl makes a copy.
m3d.tool.move_where_copy: Click where it goes, or type a distance. Ctrl moves instead.
m3d.tool.stopped_after: Stopped where it touches, after {d}. Turn off Collide (bottom right) to pass through.
m3d.tool.dim_start: Click a corner to measure from, or an edge (on an arc or circle: its radius or diameter).
m3d.tool.dim_start_resize: Click a corner or an edge to dimension, or type a length to resize what you just dimensioned.
m3d.model.there_is_nothing_on_that_side: there is nothing on that side to move
m3d.model.a_face_would_shrink_to_nothing: a face would shrink to nothing or turn inside out
m3d.model.a_face_would_bend_out_of: a face would bend out of its plane; dimension along an edge, or along red, green or blue
m3d.model.only_arcs_circles_and_polygons: Only arcs, circles and polygons have a radius.
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_that: This curve bounds a face that leaves its plane (it was pushed or pulled): its radius cannot change now.
m3d.model.a_curve_needs_two_points_or: A curve needs two points or more.
m3d.model.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: This curve can no longer be edited (it was stretched or split); draw it again.
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_erase: This curve bounds a face: erase the face first, or draw a new curve.
m3d.model.choose_a_path_one_or_more: Choose a path: one or more connected edges.
m3d.model.the_path_branches_select_one_c: The path branches: select one chain of edges, with no forks.
m3d.model.the_path_is_in_more_than: The path is in more than one piece: select one connected chain of edges.
m3d.model.the_path_needs_at_least_one: The path needs at least one edge.
m3d.model.the_path_has_an_edge_of: The path has an edge of no length.
m3d.model.the_face_lies_along_the_path: The face lies along the path: turn it to cross the path (Follow me sweeps it along the path, square to it).
m3d.model.the_path_turns_straight_back_o: The path turns straight back on itself.
m3d.model.the_path_turns_too_sharply_her: The path turns too sharply here.
m3d.model.bad_image: That image can't be kept: only PNG, JPEG and WebP images under 18 MB.
m3d.model.bad_light: That light can't be kept: it needs a kind and a place.
m3d.tool.light_where: Click where the {kind} goes: on a ceiling or wall it sits just off the face.
m3d.tool.light_aim: Click what the spotlight points at.
m3d.model.that_is_further_than_this_face: That is further than this face allows: a side would turn inside out.
That is further than this face allows: the new outline would cross itself.

ccdwg.write.nurbs_down.one: {n} NURBS surface was written as plain SURFACE ({version} has no NURBSURFACE; as AutoCAD and the ODA File Converter save it down, with the ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP marker that turns it back into a NURBS surface in R2013+).

ccdwg.write.nurbs_up.other: {n} surfaces saved down from NURBSURFACE were written as NURBSURFACE again (its NURBS fields were not kept by the save-down).

input.style.modelcraft.hint: ModelCraft's own toolbar and its push-pull keys: L line, R rectangle, P push/pull, M move, O orbit. The middle button orbits; the right button (or Shift and the middle button) pans.
input.style.pushpull.hint: A menu bar (File, Edit, View, Camera, Draw, Tools, Window) over a row of the main tools, with the single-letter keys of push-pull modelers: L line, R rectangle, P push/pull, M move, Q rotate, S scale, E eraser, G component.
input.style.modeler.hint: A header menu bar (File, Edit, View, Select, Add, Object, Mesh) and the keys of mesh modelers: W select, G grab, R rotate and S scale at once (X, Y or Z locks an axis), E push/pull, B rectangle, X delete, A select all, Shift+D duplicate, Ctrl+G group. The middle button orbits, Shift and the middle button pan, Ctrl and the middle button zoom.
